title: Badge on the corner
summary: Pin the badge so its centre sits on the avatar's top-right corner.
brief: Take the badge out of the avatar's flow and place it so its centre sits exactly on the avatar's top-right corner, whatever the badge's size.
hints: An absolutely positioned element is placed against its nearest positioned ancestor.
position: relative on .avatar, position: absolute with top: 0 and right: 0 on .badge puts the badge in the corner.
To centre it on the corner instead, shift it by half its own size: transform: translate(50%, -50%).
solutionNotes: position: relative makes the avatar the containing block without moving it. top: 0; right: 0 lines the badge's corner up with the avatar's; translate(50%, -50%) moves it by half its own width and height, so its centre lands on the corner at any size.
